title: Estagiário de engenharia
description:
Vaga de Estagiário em Engenharia Civil

**Requisitos:**

  • Estar cursando Engenharia Civil a partir do 4º período (ou equivalente, com noções básicas de estruturas, materiais de construção e topografia).

  • Interesse em projetos de infraestrutura e construção civil.

  • Conhecimentos em ferramentas como AutoCAD, Excel e normas técnicas (ABNT) são diferenciais.

  • Proatividade, boa comunicação e trabalho em equipe.

  • Disponibilidade para início imediato ou em até 30 dias.

**Responsabilidades:**

  • Auxiliar na elaboração de projetos e desenhos técnicos sob supervisão de engenheiros sêniores.

  • Participar de visitas a canteiros de obras para monitoramento de execução e relatórios de progresso.

  • Apoiar na análise de orçamentos, especificações de materiais e conformidade com normas de segurança.

  • Contribuir em reuniões de equipe e na pesquisa de soluções inovadoras para desafios de engenharia.

  • Realizar tarefas administrativas relacionadas a licitações e documentação técnica.

  • Auxiliar na condução e verificação do andamento dos serviços da obra.

**Benefícios:**

  • Bolsa-auxílio competitiva (R$ 1.200,00 mensais, conforme Lei do Estágio).

  • Vale-transporte (R$ 25/dia) e seguro de vida.

  • Oportunidade de aprendizado prático com mentoria de profissionais experientes.

  • Possibilidade de efetivação após o término do estágio, com base no desempenho.

  • Ambiente colaborativo com foco em desenvolvimento profissional e inovação sustentável.

Se você é um estudante de Engenharia Civil motivado para ganhar experiência real no mercado, esta é a oportunidade ideal para aplicar seus conhecimentos acadêmicos e crescer na carreira

**Como se candidatar:** Envie seu currículo atualizado e uma carta de apresentação para o e-mail para , com o assunto "Vaga Estagiário Engenharia Civil - (Seu Nome)". Inclua seu período atual no curso e por que você se interessa pela vaga. Selecionaremos candidatos para entrevistas na próxima semana.

Estamos ansiosos para receber sua candidatura e ajudar a construir o futuro da engenharia civil com talentos como o seu Se precisar de ajustes no anúncio, como inclusão de mais detalhes sobre a empresa ou benefícios específicos, é só me avisar.

title: Tecnico de Enfermagem
description:
Descrição da Vaga:


Prestar assistencia de enfermagem de alta qualidade, com responsabilidade e empatia, aos pacientes sob seus cuidados, seguindo rigorosamente as orientacoes e protocolos estabelecidos pela equipe de saude. Garantir o bem-estar e a seguranca dos pacientes, contribuindo para a recuperacao e manutencao da saude, atraves de praticas tecnicas humanizadas, enquanto colabora de forma eficaz com treinamento dos tecnicos de enfermagem no momento de admissao dos pacientes no domicilio.

Requisitos Desejáveis:


Prestar cuidados de enfermagem aos pacientes em domicílio, incluindo higiene pessoal, alimentação, mobilização, administração de medicamentos e controle de sinais vitais, conforme o plano de atendimento.

ação de Medicamentos:**

  • Administrar medicamentos via oral, tópica, subcutânea, intramuscular e intravenosa, seguindo rigorosamente as prescrições médicas e registrando todas as administrações no prontuário do paciente.

  • **Monitoramento de Sinais Vitais:**

  • Verificar e registrar regularmente os sinais vitais dos pacientes, como pressão arterial, temperatura, pulso e respiração, e comunicar imediatamente ao enfermeiro supervisor qualquer alteração significativa.

  • **Curativos e Cuidados com Feridas:**

  • Realizar curativos em feridas, seguindo as orientações do enfermeiro responsável e os protocolos da empresa, monitorando a evolução da cicatrização e prevenindo infecções.

  • **Educação e Orientação:**

  • Orientar o técnico de enfermagem no momento da admissão do paciente, seus familiares sobre cuidados com a saúde, administração de medicamentos e o uso correto de equipamentos médicos, promovendo a adesão ao tratamento.

  • **Documentação e Relatórios:**

  • Manter registros detalhados e precisos de todas as atividades realizadas, incluindo a evolução clínica do paciente, administração de medicamentos e observações relevantes, utilizando os sistemas de registro da empresa.

  • **Supervisão de Equipamentos:**

  • Garantir a correta utilização e manutenção dos equipamentos de saúde utilizados no atendimento domiciliar, reportando qualquer necessidade de manutenção ou substituição.

  • **Comunicação com a Equipe de Saúde:**

  • Manter comunicação constante com a equipe de saúde, relatando mudanças no estado clínico do paciente, dificuldades encontradas e solicitando suporte sempre que necessário.

  • **Cumprimento de Protocolos de Segurança:**

  • Seguir todas as normas de biossegurança, prevenção de infecções e prevenção de lesão por pressão, garantindo um ambiente seguro para o paciente e para si mesmo.

  • **Acompanhamento de Procedimentos:**

  • Auxiliar o enfermeiro e outros profissionais durante procedimentos mais complexos realizados em domicílio, garantindo que os padrões de qualidade e segurança sejam mantidos.

  • **Relatórios e Comunicação:**

  • Elaborar relatórios detalhados sobre as condições do paciente, intervenções realizadas e orientações passadas à família, assegurando que todas as informações sejam comunicadas adequadamente à equipe de saúde.

description:

Somos a Doctoralia, empresa do grupo Docplanner, e estamos presentes em 13 países, sendo responsáveis por atender mais de 55 milhões de pacientes e processar mais de 17 milhões de agendamentos de consultas por mês

title: Assistente Social
description:
Jeito DaVita

O Jeito de Ser DaVita significa que nós dedicamos nossas Mentes, Corações e Mãos para atingir a Missão, vivenciar os Valores e construir uma Aldeia saudável. Cuidamos uns dos outros com a mesma intensidade com que cuidamos dos nossos pacientes.

Gostou? Junte-se a nós e faça a diferença na sua vida e na de nossos pacientes Vamos juntos construir a melhor comunidade de saúde que o mundo já viu

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Atendimento periódico aos pacientes e familiares;
  • Entrevistar e orientar os pacientes em relação à obtenção do transporte gratuito e na documentação para tal como também na obtenção de medicação de alto custo;

  • Ensino Superior completo em Serviço Social;
  • CRESS ativo e regular;
  • Disponibilidade para atuar 30 horas semanais (150 horas mensais);
  • Experiência anterior com atendimento clínico;
  • Desejável vivência com pacientes em tratamento renal;
  • Desejável conhecimento do processo do INSS.

Informações adicionais

O que oferecemos?

  • Plano de Saúde: para cuidar do seu bem-estar e da sua família. "Porque saúde é o que interessa."
  • Plano Odontológico: para que o seu sorriso fique sempre impecável e bonito.
  • Convênio com Wellhub (Gympass): para manter sua saúde em dia.
  • Convênio com Farmácia: porque prevenir é tão importante quanto remediar.
  • Convênio com Sesc: porque ter desconto em passeios e hotéis é tudo de bom
  • Convênio com Escola de Idiomas: para você arrasar no trabalho e no karaokê.
  • Convênio com Empresa de Seguros: porque seguro nunca é demais
  • Vale Transporte: para facilitar o seu deslocamento.
  • Vale Alimentação: porque fazer compras vale mais que mil palavras.
  • Day Off: para comemorar o dia do seu aniversário.
  • Kit Bebê: produtos essenciais para ajudar o(a) seu(sua) pequeno(a).
  • Kit Natal: porque ganhar mimos é sempre bom, principalmente no Natal.
  • Programa Assistencial: sua saúde mental é nossa prioridade.
  • Aplicativo Nav Dasa: para cuidar da sua saúde aonde você estiver.
  • Empréstimo consignado: uma ajuda financeira é sempre bem-vinda
    Programa de Reconhecimento por Tempo de Casa: reconhecemos a dedicação dos colegas que contribuem para o crescimento da DaVita

Local de trabalho: Rua Pereira Landim, nº 54 - Ramos | CEP:

Horário de trabalho: JORNADA 30H SEMANAL - 6h DIA - SEG A SEX 150H MENSAL

Mais inclusão: Vaga elegível para pessoas com deficiência.

A DaVita é uma empresa de saúde que oferece serviços de diálise de alta qualidade em todo o Brasil. Chegamos ao Brasil em 2015 e no ano seguinte estávamos com 7 operações. Nossa estratégia de crescimento contínuo e dinâmico conta atualmente com mais de 100 operações.

Estamos presentes em 17 estados, atendendo mais de 20 mil pacientes com um time de mais de 6 mil colegas. No mundo, estamos presentes em 12 países, cuidando de mais de 200 mil pacientes renais em mais de 3 mil centros de diálise.

Atuamos em operações hospitalares e com clínicas para pacientes crônicos, além de um centro de acesso vascular. Prezamos pela Trilogia do Cuidado, pilar que guia a melhoria contínua na vida dos nossos pacientes, dos nossos colegas e do nosso mundo.

Nossos valores refletem o jeito DaVita de ser e imprimem em nosso dia a dia o comprometimento constante com excelência em servir, integridade, trabalho em equipe, aprimoramento contínuo, realização pessoal e diversão.

title: Cozinheiro de Hospital
description:
Preparar as refeições de acordo com o cardápio planejado, aperfeiçoando as receitas a fim de tornar os alimentos atraentes, seguindo as normas das Boas Práticas de Manipulação de Alimentos para garantia de um alimento seguro.
• Preparar as refeições de acordo com os cardápios do dia, observando a orientação específica para cada dieta;
• Receber e conferir os gêneros alimentícios solicitados ao estoque, para a confecção dos pratos, responsabilizando-se por eles;
• Fazer a requisição do material necessário para o pré-preparo do próximo cardápio;
• Coordenar e/ou executar o pré-preparo e preparo das refeições, de acordo com os cardápios planejados pela Nutricionista;
• Fazer a medição das temperaturas e coletar as amostras de todos os itens preparados para cada refeição, garantindo segurança e rastreabilidade dos alimentos;
• Preparar e supervisionar as refeições dos pacientes e dos funcionários;
• Orientar os auxiliares de nutrição, quantos às técnicas de pré-preparo e preparo das refeições;
• Colaborar com a Nutricionista na elaboração e planejamento dos cardápios;
• Manter os materiais, equipamentos e dependências de trabalho limpos e organizados, adequados para o desenvolvimento das atividades;
• Notificar a Nutricionista sobre a necessidade de consertos, reparos e substituições de materiais, equipamentos e instalações;
• Manter rígido controle quanto as sobras e restos dos gêneros alimentícios;
• Comunicar a chefia imediata qualquer ocorrência que impossibilite a execução das preparações e/ou dietas;
• Preparar cardápios para dietas especiais, obedecendo as restrições individuais dos clientes, conforme orientação e identificação determinada pela Nutricionista;
• Acompanhar o porcionamento das baixelas, pelas copeiras, com as dietas de cada paciente;
• Acompanhar a reposição das preparações durante o período de distribuição;
• Garantir a aplicação de todas as normas do Manual de Boas Práticas no processo de produção de alimentos e comunicar imediatamente à nutricionista caso algum procedimento saia do padrão, para fins de avaliação da segurança do alimento produzido.
Escolaridade: Ensino Médio completo;
DESEJÁVEL:
Cursos específicos na área, como Técnicas de Preparação de Alimentos e Boas Práticas na Manipulação de Alimentos;

Sobre a Karoon Energy

A Karoon Energy é uma empresa internacional de exploração e produção de petróleo e gás natural, com projetos no Brasil, no Golfo do México e na Austrália, com ações listadas na bolsa de valores da Austrália.

A companhia detém e opera 100% do Campo de Baúna, localizado ao sul da Bacia de Santos, que compreende os reservatórios de Baúna, Piracaba e Patola. A companhia também detém os campos de Neon e Goiá, e o bloco S-M-1537, todos ao sul da Bacia de Santos.

No Golfo da América, a companhia tem uma participação não-operacional de 30% nos campos de petróleo e gás Who Dat e Dome Patrol, 16% no campo Abilene, assim como variadas participações em infraestrutura na área de exploração na costa da Louisiana (EUA).

Nossa visão é ser uma companhia líder e independente de energia, capaz de se adaptar a um mundo dinâmico de maneira inovadora e empreendedora. Nosso propósito é fornecer energia de forma segura, responsável, criando benefícios duradouros para todos os seus stakeholders.

Somos a Americanas, uma das maiores varejistas do país, com mais de 95 anos de história. title: Maintenance Technician
description:
Our people enable continuous progress. Their commitment, collective expertise, and unique capabilities are the engine room behind SBM Offshore's True. Blue. Transition. Now, see how a role change can develop you, and us, even more.

About Us:
SBM Offshore is the world's deepwater ocean-infrastructure expert. Our work is already resulting in cleaner, more efficient energy production in offshore oil and gas. True. Blue. Transition. is our promise. It means continuing to enable decarbonization and support the energy transition, while diversifying our unique capabilities to help more blue economy industries grow and thrive sustainably. Through our strategy of Advancing Our Core and Pioneering More and our values of Care, Integrity, Collaboration, and Ownership, we are sharing our experience for a better blue tomorrow.

Reports To

  • Assistant Maintenance Supervisor

Background

  • The Maintenance Technician will exhibit a high standard of safety behaviors while carrying out Engine Room maintenance and Engine Room system operation. They may be expected to perform maintenance, preservation, welding, machining, pipe and mechanical fitting and related activities. Depending on its qualifications, they act as Junior Watchkeeper.

Authority

  • The Maintenance Operator acts under the Authority of the Assistant Maintenance Supervisor and/or Engine Room Supervisor as appropriate.

Immediate Subordinates

  • Fitters designated as part of team, visitors, vendor technicians, and sub-contractors

Accountable For: Responsibilities & Standards

  • 1) Operate Engine Room Equipment and Systems and Utilities Operation
  • 1 Prepare marine Engine Room or Aft Machinery Space and Utility Systems for start-up.
  • 2 Start and monitor marine Engine Room or Aft Machinery Space and Utility Systems.
  • 3 Prepare and shutdown marine Engine Room or Aft Machinery Space and Utility Systems.
  • 4 Follow operational and safety procedures in all aspects of work.
  • 2) Perform Maintenance activities
  • 1 Isolate and reinstate marine Engine Room or Aft Machinery Space and Utility Systems for Maintenance.
  • 2 Perform scheduled and unplanned maintenance safely and effectively under PTW Risk Assessment and Management System procedures.
  • 3 Ensure work is correctly and accurately identified, recorded and communicated.
  • 4 Perform general maintenance, greasing, cleaning, filter changing and housekeeping.
  • 5 The Maintenance operator may be required to correctly operate a Lathe, Milling and Shaping Machines, Gas Arc and or Plasma cutting.
  • 6 Maintain all portable power tools to limit of responsibility. (No; electrical' work unless accredited by the electrical department).
  • 3) Monitor and Maintain Pollution Control Measures
  • 1 Ensure that any controlled process discharges from area of responsibility to the environment are within prescribed limits.
  • 2 Identify and halt any unplanned (gas or liquid discharges where possible, and reported immediately according to policy, procedure and regulation.
  • 3 Deal with equipment, waste or other materials for disposal according to the correct procedure.
  • 4 Do not waste resources such as PPE, stock items, materials, tools or spare parts.
  • 4) Emergency Response
  • 1 Carry Out Emergency Response role (See Station Bill).
  • 2 Demonstrate competence in Emergency Response drills and exercises.

Recruitment Only-Generic Functional Competencies
Offshore - Handover

Offshore - Bunkering

Offshore - Operating Engine Room Equipment

Offshore - Diagnosis and Fault Finding

Offshore - Global Enterprise Management System

Offshore - Safety Management

Offshore - Low Level Maintenance

Offshore - Condition Monitoring

Offshore - Watchkeeping

Pre-hire Qualifications And Experience

  • 3 years' experience in shipping as a watch keeping Engine Room rating, STCW Reg. AIII/4, or EOOW STCW Reg. AIII/1 ORor
  • General maintenance skills including fitting, and Coded Welding qualification.
  • VLCC /Large Seagoing Vessel Engine Room or FPSO operations experience desirable.
  • Proficiency in English at a minimum of A1 level according to the CEFR international standard.
  • Medically fit according to The Company GEMS Instruction Health Requirements to Work Offshore.

GENERAL INFORMATION
SBM Offshore N.V. is a listed holding company that is headquartered in Amsterdam. It holds direct and indirect interests in other companies that collectively with SBM Offshore N.V. form the SBM Offshore Group ("the Company"). For further information, please visit our website at The companies in which SBM Offshore N.V., directly and indirectly, owns investments are separate entities.

SBM Offshore does not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, non-disqualifying physical or mental disability, national origin, veteran status, or any other basis covered by appropriate law. All employment is decided on the basis of qualifications, merit, and business need.

title: Customs Specialist
description:

Partner with the best

Baker Hughes is a global energy technology company serving the oil and gas sector across more than 120 countries. The Commercial & Sales organization drives growth by building strong customer partnerships, commercializing hydrocarbons, and delivering integrated equipment and service solutions. With a focus on digital transformation and energy transition, the team leverages data-driven insights to optimize sales performance and maximize customer value.

It also involves maintaining communication with direct colleagues and business stakeholders regarding the design and coordination of services.

As a Customs Specialist, you will be responsible for:

  • Managing legal and administrative processes for insurance and custom clearance (from tender phase to execution phase).

  • Have strong oral and written communication skills. Strong interpersonal and leadership skills. Ability to work independently. Strong problem solving skills.

Work in a way that works for you

We recognize that everyone is different and that the way in which people want to work and deliver at their best is different for everyone too. In this role, we can offer the following flexible working patterns:

Work in a hybrid manner, from the office or from your home.

Our people are at the heart of what we do at Baker Hughes. We know we are better when all of our people are developed, engaged and able to bring their whole authentic selves to work. We invest in the health and well-being of our workforce, train and reward talent and develop leaders at all levels to bring out the best in each other.

Working for you

Our inventions have revolutionized energy for over a century. But to keep going forward tomorrow, we know we have to push the boundaries today. We prioritize rewarding those who embrace change with a package that reflects how much we value their input. Join us, and you can expect:

  • Contemporary work-life balance policies and wellbeing activities

About Us:

We are an energy technology company that provides solutions to energy and industrial customers worldwide. Built on a century of experience and conducting business in over 120 countries, our innovative technologies and services are taking energy forward – making it safer, cleaner and more efficient for people and the planet.

Join Us:

Are you seeking an opportunity to make a real difference in a company that values innovation and progress? Join us and become part of a team of people who will challenge and inspire you Let's come together and take energy forward.

title: enfermeiro - cer centro
description:
A SPDM - Associação Paulista para o Desenvolvimento da Medicina é uma Associação civil sem fins lucrativos, de natureza filantrópica, reconhecida de utilidade pública federal, estadual e no município de sua sede, respectivamente pelos decretos nos , de 04/03/1966, de 17/05/1962 e 8.911, de 30/07/1970.

A Instituição atua nos âmbitos federal, estadual e municipal, em harmonia com suas políticas de saúde e de educação, e também como organização social habilitada em vários estados, na gerência de serviços e organizações de saúde, por meio de convênios e contratos de gestão.

A diretriz primordial da Associação é sua inserção no sistema de saúde direcionada ao tratamento, prevenção de doenças e à promoção da saúde primária, secundária e terciária, estreitando laços com a comunidade local e reafirmando seu compromisso social de atender a todos, sem discriminação.

title: Architect
description:
Result of Service

The Architect reports to the Head of Brazil Office. He/She shall duly and timely perform his/her obligations, under these Terms of Reference. The consultant will work in close collaboration with the UN-Habitat's operational and technical teams.

Work Location

Home based

Expected duration

Eleven (11) months

Duties and Responsibilities

Background The main mandate of the United Nations Human Settlements Programme (UN-Habitat) is to promote sustainable development of human settlements and policies conducive to adequate housing for all. Within this framework, UN-Habitat supports central and state governments, local authorities, and other partners for the implementation of the Habitat Agenda, the 2030 Agenda, with the Sustainable Development Goals and the New Urban Agenda. UN-Habitat helps the urban poor by transforming cities into safer, more inclusive, compact, integrated, resilient and connected places with better opportunities where everyone can live with dignity. It works with organizations at every level, including all spheres of government, civil society, and the private sector to help build, manage, plan, and finance sustainable urban development. The Regional Office for Latin American and the Caribbean – ROLAC – is based in Rio de Janeiro, Brazil. The Agency puts emphasis on developing and managing activities in the host country. Indeed, for the past years, UN-Habitat has expanded its portfolio in Brazil by working with the three tiers of government to support the formulation and implementation of more effective, sustainable, participative, and socially fairer urban economic, social, and environmental policies. Through a partnership with the United Nations Office for Project Services (UNOPS) and the Municipality of Belo Horizonte, UN-Habitat is working as Implementing Agency to implement the project named "Urban Qualification in a Key Neighborhood of Belo Horizonte." UN-Habitat will focus on the outcome "Improved Belo Horizonte Municipal infrastructure and tools to develop effective options for social housing and urban planning in Izidora," which aims to enable Izidora´s population to have safe and sustainable access to community infrastructure and affordable housing. The region of Izidora corresponds to an area of about 9.5 km², in the northern vector of the city, next to the southern border of the city of Santa Luzia. This area is in the largest green area of the city, counting around 280 water sources and 64 creeks, including part of the watershed Belo Horizonte's main water source. Part of Izidora has been squatted and is divided into four urban informal settlements - Esperança, Vitória, Helena Greco and Rosa Leão – totalizing approximately 1.5 km² and hosting about 4,200 precarious homes (which could be up to 7,000 families, given that there are no precise numbers since 2010), with families in situations of extreme poverty and without any available public infrastructure and relative services, as many Brazilian cities. During the Habitat III Conference in 2016, Izidora was highlighted as one of the most serious urban land conflicts in Latin America. Therefore, the new efforts of the municipality are a recognition of the issues, as well as the urgency of acting. The interest of the Municipal Administration is to implement works and actions so that Izidora becomes a model under the principles of sustainability and resilience. This is a chance to promote an innovative experience in using the precepts of the New Urban Agenda (NUA) and the Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs) at local level to reverse a situation of socioeconomic and territorial vulnerability. To properly implement this project, an Architect is required to ensure the good execution of the work programme. Report to UN-Habitat Manager The Architect reports to the Head of Brazil Office who will evaluate him/her. Responsibilities The Architect will support the implementation of the project, and its activities, with the following responsibilities:
• Review of Program, layout, 3D modeling, façade elements, and preliminary architectural design.
• Analyze and review basic architectural projects, regarding aspects of dimensioning, urbanism, thermal comfort, ventilation, acoustics, energy efficiency, specifications of materials.
• Prepare reports and technical analysis on basic architectural projects.
• Analyze, review, and propose changes to the technical drawings to ensure quality standards.
• Apply advanced analysis techniques to propose solutions to problems related to architecture and compatibility of projects.
• Provide technical guidance to designers, planners, engineers, and architects.
• Collaborate with other team members to prepare the necessary technical documents corresponding to the project.
• Participate in meetings with other members of the technical team.
• Perform any other technical support tasks to support the project team as required. The consultant will be responsible for completing all courses and training activities that are indicated to him/her by his/her supervisor. The security course BSAFE, from UNDSS, is required to be accredited during the first month of employment. The consultant will be responsible for his/her own security, so the person should get familiarized with United Nations security mechanisms and comply with them according to the Framework of Accountability for the United Nations Security Management System. Outputs/Work Assignment The Architect shall evaluate projects for two (2) occupations of Izidora Neighborhood, which are divided into three (3) areas, and assist the implementation of the project, according to the stated responsibilities and the delivery of the following products: Product 1: Architectural Preliminary Design Description: A consortium will design the architectural preliminary design, and the Architect will analyze the delivery. The analysis includes three (3) project reviews and technical reports, up to final design approval. Expected delivery date: 80 days after signing the contract. Product 2: Basic Architectural Design Description: A consortium will design the basic architectural design, and the Architect will analyze the delivery. The analysis includes three (3) project reviews and technical reports, up to final design approval. Expected delivery date: 160 days after signing the contract. Product 3: Use, Operation, and Maintenance Manual Description: A consortium will design the manual, and the Architect will analyze the delivery. The analysis includes three (3) project reviews and technical reports, up to final design approval. Expected delivery date: 240 days after signing the contract. Product 4: Compatibility inspection – Area 1 and 2 Description: A consortium will design compatibility studies, and the Architect will verify the deliveries. The analysis includes three (3) project reviews and technical reports, up to final design approval. Expected delivery date: 330 days after signing the contract.

Qualifications/special skills

Education Required:
• Postgraduate degree (Lato or stricto sensu) in Architecture, or additional four (4) years of relevant experience to the post, beyond the requirement.
• Bachelor's degree in Architecture. Work experience:
• A minimum of six (6) years of progressively responsible experience in basic projects for housing solutions in Brazil is required.
• Experience in architectural projects for social housing is required.
• Experience in urbanistic, and landscaping projects for informal settlements is desirable.
• Previous experience within the UN System is desirable. Skills:
• Good computer skills in Windows, such as Microsoft Office, Outlook, Microsoft Teams, and Web search engines are required.
• Experience and skills in using BIM are desirable. Competencies
• Professionalism: Experience working in an inter-institutional environment, project management, monitoring-evaluation. approaches and strategies regarding good urban governance and local and regional development.
• Planning and organization: Professional approach to work, strong sense of responsibility, operate with minimal supervision. Proven organizational skills and ability to manage a workload efficiently and within set deadlines.
• Communication: Ability to write clearly and effectively. Listen to others, interpret messages correctly, and respond appropriately. Show openness in information sharing and keep everyone informed. solid abstract reasoning skills together with a proven capacity to write documents for diverse audiences.
• Teamwork: Ability to work with teams, demonstrate leadership, conflict management, and consensus facilitation skills. ability to work in a multicultural and multi-ethnic environment, and to respect diversity. sensitivity to the main streaming of vulnerability. willingness and ability to work in difficult environments. Knowledge Management
• The person must know the processes, procedures, and norms of UN-Habitat, to guarantee an adequate quality of the activities described above, following the standards of the organization.
• The person will propose formats and procedures that allow for the efficient implementation of the activities related to project development.
• The person must know the file of the Office, work with it, and ensure its proper maintenance, accessibility for all staff, and due updating.
• The person will prepare databases related to the project running.
• The person will make sure that all relevant technical information will be adequately shared with the correspondent staff.
• The person will ensure that all produced material will be fit-for-purpose and delivered, in an organized way, for posterior consultation and use of the Agency.
• The person will only share the information produced with the team agency, assuring the privacy of the content.

Languages


• English and French are the working languages of the United Nations Secretariat, and Spanish is the working language of the Regional Office.
• For the post advertised, fluency in Portuguese is required.
• Working knowledge of English or Spanish is desirable.

Additional Information

title: Sanitation Engineer
description:
Result of Service

The Sanitation Engineer (Drainage Project) reports to the Head of Brazil Office. He/She shall duly and timely perform his/her obligations, under these Terms of Reference. The consultant will work in close collaboration with the UN-Habitat's operational and technical teams.

Work Location

Home based

Expected duration

Eleven (11) months

Duties and Responsibilities

Background The main mandate of the United Nations Human Settlements Programme (UN-Habitat) is to promote sustainable development of human settlements and policies conducive to adequate housing for all. Within this framework, UN-Habitat supports central and state governments, local authorities, and other partners for the implementation of the Habitat Agenda, the 2030 Agenda, with the Sustainable Development Goals and the New Urban Agenda. UN-Habitat helps the urban poor by transforming cities into safer, more inclusive, compact, integrated, resilient and connected places with better opportunities where everyone can live with dignity. It works with organizations at every level, including all spheres of government, civil society, and the private sector to help build, manage, plan, and finance sustainable urban development. The Regional Office for Latin American and the Caribbean – ROLAC – is based in Rio de Janeiro, Brazil. The Agency puts emphasis on developing and managing activities in the host country. Indeed, for the past years, UN-Habitat has expanded its portfolio in Brazil by working with the three tiers of government to support the formulation and implementation of more effective, sustainable, participative, and socially fairer urban economic, social, and environmental policies. Through a partnership with the United Nations Office for Project Services (UNOPS) and the Municipality of Belo Horizonte, UN-Habitat is working as Implementing Agency to implement the project named "Urban Qualification in a Key Neighborhood of Belo Horizonte." UN-Habitat will focus on the outcome "Improved Belo Horizonte Municipal infrastructure and tools to develop effective options for social housing and urban planning in Izidora," which aims to enable Izidora´s population to have safe and sustainable access to community infrastructure and affordable housing. The region of Izidora corresponds to an area of about 9.5 km², in the northern vector of the city, next to the southern border of the city of Santa Luzia. This area is in the largest green area of the city, counting around 280 water sources and 64 creeks, including part of the watershed Belo Horizonte's main water source. Part of Izidora has been squatted and is divided into four urban informal settlements - Esperança, Vitória, Helena Greco and Rosa Leão – totalizing approximately 1.5 km² and hosting about 4,200 precarious homes (which could be up to 7,000 families, given that there are no precise numbers since 2010), with families in situations of extreme poverty and without any available public infrastructure and relative services, as many Brazilian cities. During the Habitat III Conference in 2016, Izidora was highlighted as one of the most serious urban land conflicts in Latin America. Therefore, the new efforts of the municipality are a recognition of the issues, as well as the urgency of acting. The interest of the Municipal Administration is to implement works and actions so that Izidora becomes a model under the principles of sustainability and resilience. This is a chance to promote an innovative experience in using the precepts of the New Urban Agenda (NUA) and the Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs) at local level to reverse a situation of socioeconomic and territorial vulnerability. To properly implement this project, a Sanitation Engineer (Drainage Project) is required to ensure the good execution of the work programme. Report to UN-Habitat Manager The Sanitation Engineer (Drainage Project) reports to the Head of Brazil Office who will evaluate him/her. Responsibilities The Sanitation Engineer (Drainage Project) will support the implementation of the project, and its activities, with the following responsibilities: a) Analyze, review, and, when necessary, suggest adjustments in drainage basic projects and ensure compatibility with sewage and water network projects designed by the local concessionaires. b) Prepare reports and technical assessments on drainage projects. c) Analyze, review, and propose changes to the technical drawings to ensure quality standards. d) Provide technical guidance to designers, planners, and engineers. e) Collaborate with other team members to prepare the necessary technical documents corresponding to the project. f) Participate in meetings with other members of the technical team. g) Perform any other technical support tasks to support the project team as required. The consultant will be responsible for completing all courses and training activities that are indicated to him/her by his/her supervisor. The security course BSAFE, from UNDSS, is required to be accredited during the first month of employment. The consultant will be responsible for his/her own security, so the person should get familiarized with United Nations security mechanisms and comply with them according to the Framework of Accountability for the United Nations Security Management System. Outputs/Work Assignment The Sanitation Engineer (Drainage Project) shall evaluate projects for two (2) occupations of Izidora Neighborhood, which are divided into three (3) areas, and assist the implementation of the project, according to the stated responsibilities and the delivery of the following products: Product 1 – Drainage projects – Area 1 Description: A consortium will develop drainage projects, and the Sanitation Engineer (Drainage Project) will analyze the deliveries. The analysis includes three (3) project reviews and technical reports, up to the final approval of the project. Expected delivery date: 65 days after signing the contract. Product 2 - Drainage projects – Area 2 Description: A consortium will develop drainage projects, and the Sanitation Engineer (Drainage Project) will analyze the deliveries. The analysis includes three (3) project reviews and technical reports, up to the final approval of the project. Expected delivery date: 130 days after signing the contract. Product 3 – Drainage projects – Area 3 Description: A consortium will develop drainage projects, and the Sanitation Engineer (Drainage Project) will analyze the deliveries. The analysis includes three (3) project reviews and technical reports, up to the final approval of the project. Expected delivery date: 195 days after signing the contract. Product 4 – Drainage analysis for degraded areas recovery plan Description: A consortium will design a recovery plan, and the Sanitation Engineer (Drainage Project) will verify the deliveries. The analysis includes three (3) project reviews and technical reports, up to the final approval of the project. Expected delivery date: 260 days after signing the contract. Product 5 – Drainage analysis for environmental assessment Description: A consortium will design an environmental analysis, and the Sanitation Engineer (Drainage Project) will verify the deliveries. The analysis includes three (3) project reviews and technical reports, up to the final approval of the project. Expected delivery date: 330 days after signing the contract.

Qualifications/special skills

Education Required:
• Postgraduate degree (Lato or stricto sensu) in Civil Engineering or related fields, or additional four (4) years of relevant experience to the post, beyond the requirement.
• Bachelor's degree in Civil Engineering or related fields. Work experience:
• At least six (6) years of professional experience in sanitation engineering roles is required, especially related to drainage and sustainable urban drainage design.
• Experience in the use of nature-based solutions is desirable.
• Experience in design and/or work in informal settlements is desirable.
• Previous experience within the UN System is desirable. Skills:
• Good computer skills in Windows, such as Microsoft Office, Outlook, Microsoft Teams, and Web search engines are required.
• Experience and skills in using AutoCAD Civil 3D is desirable. Competencies
• Professionalism: Experience working in an inter-institutional environment, project management, monitoring-evaluation. approaches and strategies regarding good urban governance and local and regional development.
• Planning and organization: Professional approach to work, strong sense of responsibility, operate with minimal supervision. Proven organizational skills and ability to manage a workload efficiently and within set deadlines.
• Communication: Ability to write clearly and effectively. Listen to others, interpret messages correctly, and respond appropriately. Show openness in information sharing and keep everyone informed. solid abstract reasoning skills together with a proven capacity to write documents for diverse audiences.
• Teamwork: Ability to work with teams, demonstrate leadership, conflict management, and consensus facilitation skills. ability to work in a multicultural and multi-ethnic environment, and to respect diversity. sensitivity to the main streaming of vulnerability. willingness and ability to work in difficult environments. Knowledge Management

• The person will propose formats and procedures that allow for the efficient implementation of the activities related to project development.
• The person must know the file of the Office, work with it, and ensure its proper maintenance, accessibility for all staff, and due updating.
• The person will prepare databases related to the project running.
• The person will make sure that all relevant technical information will be adequately shared with the correspondent staff.
• The person will ensure that all produced material will be fit-for-purpose and delivered, in an organized way, for posterior consultation and use of the Agency.
• The person will only share the information produced with the team agency, assuring the privacy of the content.

Languages


• English and French are the working languages of the United Nations Secretariat, and Spanish is the working language of the Regional Office.
• For the post advertised, fluency in Portuguese is required.
• Working knowledge of English or Spanish is desirable.

5 anos em auditoria interna, externa ou em consultoria relacionado com gestão de riscos, controles internos e auditoria.

Conhecimento e experiência no mercado financeiro e de seguros também será um diferencial.

O objetivo deste cargo é atuar na implementação da auditoria contínua na companhia e também executar auditorias internas de maior complexidade em todas as áreas da empresa.

Implementar e desenvolver o modelo de auditoria contínua nos controles dos principais riscos da companhia através de análise de dados e Power BI.

Realizar follow-up de planos de ação junto as áreas e verificar as evidências de implementação.

VAGA DIARISTA, SEM POSSIBILIDADE DE CONCILIAR COM OUTRO EMPREGO.

A SPDM - Associação Paulista para o Desenvolvimento da Medicina é uma Associação civil sem fins lucrativos, de natureza filantrópica, reconhecida de utilidade pública federal, estadual e no município de sua sede, respectivamente pelos decretos nos , de 04/03/1966, de 17/05/1962 e 8.911, de 30/07/1970.

A Instituição atua nos âmbitos federal, estadual e municipal, em harmonia com suas políticas de saúde e de educação, e também como organização social habilitada em vários estados, na gerência de serviços e organizações de saúde, por meio de convênios e contratos de gestão.

A diretriz primordial da Associação é sua inserção no sistema de saúde direcionada ao tratamento, prevenção de doenças e à promoção da saúde primária, secundária e terciária, estreitando laços com a comunidade local e reafirmando seu compromisso social de atender a todos, sem discriminação.

Com o crescimento Institucional, a SPDM vem expandindo sua área de atuação com projetos, em desenvolvimento, na área da Assistência Social e na área Educacional. Toda essa gama de atividades consolida, cada vez mais, a SPDM como uma instituição filantrópica de grande porte, que busca a sustentabilidade econômica, social e ambiental.

Suas quatro superintendências - Hospital São Paulo, Instituições Afiliadas, Programa de Atenção Integral à Saúde (PAIS) e Educação - são gerenciadas por profissionais de alta capacitação técnica e notável saber.

Assim, a SPDM contribui de forma efetiva para a melhoria contínua dos serviços prestados pelo Sistema Único de Saúde do Brasil, visando principalmente garantir a universalidade e as oportunidades de acesso à saúde, necessárias ao desenvolvimento humano e social do cidadão. Para tanto, associa o melhor da tecnologia com atendimento médico de alta qualidade, respaldado por equipes multiprofissionais, formadas por enfermeiros, fisioterapeutas, farmacêuticos, nutricionistas, fonoaudiólogos, bioquímicos, psicólogos, tecnólogos, assistentes sociais e dentistas, entre outros.

O Programa de Atenção Integral à Saúde iniciou suas atividades no ano de 2001 no município de São Paulo, se estendendo para outros municípios e estados. Desde o início de suas atividades, o PAIS busca, em parceria com a gestão pública, o crescimento e a consolidação dos serviços de saúde ofertados aos usuários do SUS.

O Programa tem como objetivo garantir mudanças nos indicadores e na qualidade de vida da população, pautado, entre outros, pelos princípios da integralidade e da equidade, com uma visão estratégica da gestão dos serviços de saúde, definida em um processo de aprimoramento contínuo.

Inclusão


A SPDM oferece oportunidades de trabalho em suas unidades hospitalares, com plano de carreira, para pessoas com deficiência. Para tanto, periodicamente publica anúncio recrutando esses profissionais, nos principais jornais de São Paulo e dos municípios em que se localizam suas unidades.

Missão

Promover ações em saúde integradas com a gestão pública, em benefício da população de forma ética e humanizada, qualidade técnica, com compromisso social e ambiental.

Visão

Ser referência em gestão de serviços em saúde, abrangendo todos os níveis da assistência, garantindo atendimento com qualidade à população dos municípios e estados parceiros.

Valores

  • Profissionalismo
  • Qualidade
  • Responsabilidade Social
  • Trabalho em equipe
  • Ética

description:

Como é o ambiente de trabalho?
Na DPSP (lojas, CDs e corporativo), nosso trabalho impacta a saúde e o bem-estar de milhões de brasileiros todos os dias. Nossa força está nas pessoas que colocam saúde em primeiro lugar, atuam com ética, colaboração e respeito às diferenças. Junte-se a nós e seja protagonista na transformação da jornada de saúde de quem confia na gente.

Mais do que igualdade, buscamos equidade: Aqui, temos espaço para sermos autênticos, independentemente de gênero, etnia, raça, orientação sexual, credo ou deficiência. Destacamos que todas as nossas vagas são abertas para pessoas com deficiência (PCD). #VemSerDPSP

O Grupo DPSP valoriza a sua Privacidade e a Proteção dos seus dados pessoais. Em caso de dúvidas sobre o tratamento de dados pessoais no processo de atração e seleção, acesse nosso Aviso de Privacidade para Candidatos:

Responsabilidades da Oportunidade

  • Demonstrar e apresentar produtos, contribuindo para uma experiência de compra encantadora;
  • Realizar a reposição de mercadorias, mantendo a loja sempre abastecida;
  • Garantir a organização e limpeza da loja;
  • Atuar no fechamento de caixa;
  • Apoiar nas demais atividades do dia a dia da loja e do time de vendas.

Requisitos

O que consideramos importante para que você faça parte do nosso time?

  • Ter 18 anos ou mais;

  • Ensino médio completo.

  • Espírito colaborativo, boa comunicação e disposição para trabalhar em equipe;

  • Foco no cliente: entender sua jornada e buscar soluções que proporcionem uma experiência única e personalizada;
  • Proatividade, iniciativa e praticidade para lidar com os desafios do dia a dia.

Não é necessário ter experiência Valorizamos sua vontade de aprender e crescer com a gente.

Sobre a Organização
Estamos há mais de 130 anos presentes no dia a dia dos brasileiros.

A nossa história como Grupo DPSP começa lá em 2011, com a fusão dessas redes de farmácias.

E desde então, os nossos mais de 30 mil colaboradores constroem novos capítulos dessa história diariamente, levando soluções de saúde para as milhares de pessoas que frequentam as nossas mais de 1.600 lojas e 6 centros de distribuição espalhados em 9 estados do Brasil e Distrito Federal.

description:

  • Avaliar a necessidade de acionamento do TIRR – Código amarelo, de forma fidedigna, informando os dados do paciente, bem como a assistência adequada e preenchimento correto dos formulários;

Garantir a extração eficiente, segura e sustentável de petróleo e gás natural, aplicando princípios avançados de engenharia para otimizar a produção, reduzir custos e minimizar impactos ambientais. O engenheiro de produção atua como elo estratégico entre tecnologia, reservatório, operações e gestão, assegurando que os recursos energéticos sejam explorados de forma responsável e alinhada às normas regulatórias.

  • Garantir conformidade com normas de segurança, ambientais e regulatórias.
  • Elaborar relatórios periódicos sobre desempenho e propor ajustes para maximizar monetização e utilização de reservas.
  • Desenvolver e implementar melhores práticas e inovações na área de E&P.
  • Interagir ativamente com profissionais da área de E&P, departamentos de suporte e órgãos em busca das alternativas de otimizar a produção e equipamentos envolvidos na extração.
  • Participar de iniciativas processos de Excelência Operacional, desenvolvimento de ferramentas para acompanhamento de projetos e portfolio;
  • Articular com as áreas de reservatório/exploração para o acompanhamento e execução do plano de desenvolvimento do campo e gerenciamento da produção, para garantir o progresso do projeto;
  • Contribuir para alcançar metas do projeto e identificar recursos, processos, stakeholders e riscos associados;
  • Facilitar a visibilidade e coordenação do projeto com as partes interessadas internas e externas;
  • Utilizar softwares e outras ferramentas para realizar análises e avaliações relacionadas à qualidade das decisões e desenvolvimento do projeto;
  • Utilizar recursos internos e externos para a avaliação do projeto.
  • Medir o desempenho da produção usando ferramentas e técnicas adequadas;
  • Colaborar com o gerenciamento de riscos na elaboração de planos de ação;
  • Manter documentação abrangente dos processos e procedimentos;

Para se candidatar, você precisa de:

  • Formação ou especialização em Engenharia de Petróleo e gás (graduação ou mestrado).
  • Experiência com softwares de engenharia de petróleo e reservatório.
  • Domínio de técnicas modernas de extração e equipamentos.
  • Conhecimento profundo dos processos de produção e operações.
  • Familiaridade com normas de segurança e padrões ambientais.
  • Capacidade analítica para interpretar dados complexos e tomar decisões informadas.

Por aqui, vivemos nossa cultura no dia a dia, guiados por esses
5 pilares
:

Own It:
Espírito de dono traz liberdade. Valorizamos a autonomia e a proatividade, somos responsáveis pelo que entregamos e buscamos sempre evoluir o nosso negócio.

Live the Ride:
Feito é melhor que perfeito. Aprendemos com erros e vemos desafios como oportunidades de crescimento.

No Bullshit:
Agimos com simplicidade. Somos práticos, sinceros e valorizamos feedbacks, usando transparência para evoluir, mesmo em erros.

Team Play:
Quer ir rápido? Vá sozinho(a). Quer ir longe? Vá em equipe. Aprendemos uns com os outros, e a colaboração é a chave do sucesso.

The Reason:
O cliente não tem razão, ele é a razão. Queremos impactá-lo positivamente e ver as melhorias que trazemos à sua vida.

title: Analista Contábil
description:
Na APEPI, acreditamos que dados bem cuidados também são uma forma de cuidado com as pessoas.

Buscamos alguém que queira transformar números em informações confiáveis, apoiar decisões importantes e contribuir para uma organização que atua diariamente pela saúde, dignidade e inclusão.

Se você gosta de entender processos, conectar áreas e garantir que a informação contábil reflita a realidade das operações, essa vaga pode ser pra você.

Missão do cargo
Garantir a integração, análise e confiabilidade das informações contábeis e financeiras no ERP, assegurando que os registros representem fielmente a realidade econômica da organização e apoiem o fechamento contábil e a tomada de decisão.

Principais responsabilidades

  • Analisar e integrar informações contábeis e financeiras no ERP (Odoo).
  • Parametrizar e acompanhar plano de contas, categorias e integrações entre módulos.
  • Realizar conciliações contábeis e apoiar o fechamento mensal e anual.
  • Gerar e validar demonstrativos contábeis (BP, DRE, DFC) e relatórios gerenciais.
  • Identificar inconsistências e propor melhorias nos processos e no uso do sistema.
  • Atuar como ponte entre contabilidade, gestão e áreas técnicas, apoiando boas práticas e governança.

O que esperamos de você

  • Formação superior em Contabilidade, Administração, Economia ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência entre 3 e 5 anos em rotinas contábeis e/ou financeiras, com uso de ERP.
  • Boa base em contabilidade geral, conciliações, fechamento contábil e demonstrativos.
  • Excel intermediário ou avançado para análises e controles.

Vai ser um diferencial se você tiver:

  • Vivência com ERP Odoo ou participação em projetos de integração contábil-sistêmica.

Conhecimentos e habilidades importantes

  • Capacidade analítica e atenção aos detalhes.
  • Visão sistêmica e entendimento de processos ponta a ponta.
  • Comunicação clara e colaborativa (contábil gestão TI).
  • Organização, senso de responsabilidade e compromisso com prazos.
  • Proatividade, ética e cuidado com a qualidade da informação.

O que oferecemos

  • Salário: R$ 5.200,00
  • Jornada: 40 horas semanais, de segunda à sexta-feira
  • Ambiente acolhedor, colaborativo e orientado ao impacto social
  • Assistência Médica
  • Vale Refeição
  • Vale Transporte
  • Benefício de Cuidado Emocional
  • Benefício Educacional
  • Seguro de Vida

Como será o processo seletivo

  • Triagem de currículos
  • Entrevista online
  • Entrevista presencial com a equipe (com pequeno teste prático ou estudo de caso)
  • Proposta e início do processo de integração

title: TMF Officer
description:
The Research and Development Department includes three clusters of disease expert teams NTD Mycetoma and Leishmaniasis; NTD Chagas, Filarial, and HAT; and Viral Diseases. These teams drive therapeutic innovation from the lab bench to the patientbedside, advancing DNDi's portfolio of treatment candidates from the outset (with the design of target product profiles) to theend point (enabling patients' access to new treatments).

DNDi established its Latin American office in Rio de Janeiro in 2004. Since then, DNDi Latin America has made extensive contributions to advancing R&D and access partnerships across the region's diverse health ecosystems. Its work spanning neglected diseases such as Chagas disease, leishmaniasis, hepatitis C, and dengue plays a central role in delivering DNDi's global strategy. The office also leads advocacy efforts and drives capacity-building initiatives through multi-country clinical research and drug discovery platforms.

The Trial Master File Management Officer is responsible to compile, maintain and archive all TMF related documents in order to prepare the submissions to any international authorities for one or several different drug registrations and to comply with DNDi's SOPs and GCP requirements for filing and archiving of clinical trials. The incumbent will plan and coordinates the overall management of the Trial Master Files and associated processes following GCP and ICH, including system and tool development, business process documentation and is ultimately responsible to ensure inspection readiness for the TMF across all Disease

Programme/Cluster.

  • Manage document control processes and systems for GCP activities in compliance with internal procedures and policies and ensure compliance with ICH/GCP and relevant international and local legislation and regulations.
  • Assess suitability of documentation for filing (accuracy, completeness, and legibility).
  • Ensure high quality Trial Master File set-up and management (on-boarding of study contributors, completion of the Trial Master File management plan, study specific preparation of documents in the system, periodic reviews, etc.).
  • Serve as a Trial Master File contact for documentation to the project team and cross functional departments
  • Follow up on open record management queries and ensure their full resolution.
  • Assist in periodic Trial Master File audits.
  • Plan and perform internal periodic quality check activities of the Trial Master File, provide findings to the clinical team and provide support to the team to ensure compliance is maintained to meet internal and external quality standards.
  • Provide support to clinical teams during regulatory inspections for record organization and retrieval.
  • Continuously monitor, identify and report quality problems and record management work practices, make

recommendations for resolutions, and initiate actions required to resolve quality and efficiency problems.

Additional /specific/projects Responsibilities

  • Support the creation and/or update of applicable SOPs, Guidance Documents, templates etc., as applicable.
  • Continuously oversee and identify rooms for improvement for document management processes, in particular in the areas of archiving management. Support implementation activities as applicable.
  • TMF Officer reports to Senior Clinical Project Manager.
  • Works with all teams, and all units in the all departments.
  • Coordinate with external contacts under supervision. Support information exchange.
  • First university degree (Bachelor level) in a relevant field if required by the function.
  • At least 3 years of experience or equivalent internship/training in the area.
  • Proven ability to work effectively in a team environment and matrix structure.
  • Experience working in the public and private sector is highly desirable.

Critical Skills And Attributes

  • Emerging technical skills in a defined field.
  • Ability to support standard and routine activities independently.
  • Willingness to learn and apply feedback to evolve into higher-level specialist roles.
  • Ability to use initiative, prioritize, multi-task, and work well under pressure to meet deadlines.
  • Clear and systematic thinking that demonstrates good judgment and problem solving competencies.
  • Ability to work effectively as part of a multicultural team.
  • Well organized and structured.
  • Good analytical skills.
  • Provide specialist services to operational line or project team.
  • Ability solve non-routine problems on a case by case/project basis.
  • Has certain autonomy for taking actions and decisions.

R& D Technical Skills

  • Good Knowledge of regulatory (GCP, GLP and GMP) particularly in TMF management.
  • Strong Technical writing skills (procedures, protocols and reports.
  • Fluency in English.
  • Proficiency in local languages desirable.
  • Excellent knowledge of Microsoft Suite.
  • Good knowledge of Veeva (eTMF maintenance, improvement, review release, set-up, etc…. ).

DNDi is committed to building a diverse, equitable and truly inclusive organisation. Our success and global reach are dependent upon our ability to encourage diversity and draw on the skills, understanding and experience of all our people. We particularly welcome applications from those who are underrepresented in at DNDi and across the sector, especially women, and including, but not limited to, black and minority ethnic candidates, and those with other protected characteristic.

title: Laboratory Supervisor
description:
JOB PURPOSE

This position is accountable for providing expertise to customers, related to all aspects of a project from sample collection protocols to analysis requirements needed to meet criteria of project, to QC and reporting of data in the geological services lab. The Geologist must be available to execute petrographic descriptions, data integrations with generated data and discuss results with customers, also provide interpretive reports when necessary.

QHSSE

Required to follow all QHSSE and Compliance policies and procedures and complete training by using all systems as defined by Stratum. You are responsible for creating opportunities for improvement, report and investigate incidents, non-conformities, and operative issues. Employees must submit STAR cards and report any risks identified on the job. Participation in meetings and general activities created to help in prevent risks is required. The employee is responsible to stop the job and assess whether the conditions are safe to continue work. If applicable, must be responsible for completing all required QHSSE and Compliance reporting.

Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Schedule, coordinate and organize personnel to execute the geological services.
  • Generate QC to the Thin sections elaborated on the TS Lab.
  • Generate Thin Section descriptions, mainly presalt samples.
  • Data Integration and QC within Thin section description, XRD, XRF, LPSA,
  • Generate interpretive reports and give presentations based on geological analysis.
  • Coordination between clients and laboratory personnel and management to receive, execute and/or send the samples abroad.
  • Attend meetings with clients for projects follow up and/or present the services.
  • Request materials and maintenance to complete the jobs in a timely matter.
  • Report generated revenue according Stratum policies and required dates.
  • Travel to conferences, training or support may be required on occasion in and outside of Stratum companies.
  • Must understand and comply with all safety rules and company policies of Stratum.
  • Know and understand Stratum Quality Policy and comply with all requirements of the Quality Systems Manual, Operating and Technical Procedures and Workplace Instructions.
  • Coordinate with other staff/labs to ensure samples are completed in a timely manner, and that proper protocols are followed.
  • Perform various other duties and activities as assigned by supervisor within the physical constraints of the job.

Skills and Knowledge:

  • Petrographic descriptions
  • Personnel Management
  • English and Portuguese languages

Minimum Qualifications:

Essential

  • BSc Geology or related

Preferred

  • 7+ years' experience

title: assistant marketing manager
description:
Company Description

Emerging as a pioneering French luxury hospitality brand in 1964, Sofitel brings French zest and inspires heartfelt encounters to the most sought-after destinations worldwide. Seamlessly melding local culture with the French zest for life through remarkable savoir-faire and generous service, Sofitel is for free-minded travelers and arts and culture aficionados who have an appreciation for a refined and understated sense of modern luxury.

THE HOTEL

Sofitel, a global reference in French luxury hospitality, announces the transformation of Sofitel Rio de Janeiro Ipanema into its first flagship hotel in Brazil, with an expected opening by the end of 2026.

Located on Ipanema Beach, the hotel will feature 172 rooms and embody the brand's contemporary vision of luxury, experience, and service excellence.

Join the team of talents who will bring this new icon of luxury hospitality in Brazil to life.

Job Description

THE POSITION

The Assistant Marketing Manager - Social Media, Brand & Content supports the hotel's digital presence and brand strategy, managing content and campaigns across social media, websites, OTAs, and CRM platforms. This role plays a key part in shaping the hotel's digital identity, creating engaging content, and supporting the launch of new or renovated properties. The position ensures consistent messaging, guest engagement, and alignment with revenue and brand objectives.

KEY ROLES & RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Lead the digital and social media strategy for a new luxury hotel brand, shaping its presence from pre-opening through ongoing operations to express a refined, aspirational, and globally recognized brand identity;
  • Create, curate, and oversee compelling content across social media, digital platforms, and multimedia campaigns, highlighting the hotel's unique services, experiences, and lifestyle;
  • Develop and execute integrated digital marketing campaigns across Rooms, F&B, MICE, Spa, and other offerings to drive engagement, brand awareness, and revenue growth;
  • Manage pre-opening initiatives, including website setup, social media launch, and digital campaigns, to generate interest and anticipation ahead of the brand's debut;
  • Monitor digital performance, analyze engagement metrics, and optimize content and campaigns to maximize visibility, interaction, and business results;
  • Collaborate closely with marketing, revenue, and operations teams to ensure integrated strategies, consistent brand messaging, and high-end guest experiences;
  • Maintain a strong brand voice and identity across all digital channels, ensuring storytelling aligns with the hotel's global positioning;
  • Monitor social media trends, digital innovations, and best practices in luxury hospitality marketing to enhance the brand's digital presence/
  • Prepare regular reports on digital performance, KPIs, and campaign results, providing actionable insights to inform strategy and decision-making.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Communications, Hospitality Management, or related field;
  • Proven experience in social media management, digital content creation and brand marketing, preferably in luxury hospitality;
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in Portuguese and English. French is a plus;
  • Strong organizational, time-management, and project coordination skills;
  • Deep knowledge of current digital marketing concepts, trends, and innovations, with the ability to apply them strategically to elevate the brand's presence.
  • Proficiency in MS Office, social media management tools, and content creation platforms;
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities, work under pressure, and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
  • Job Category: Sales & Marketing

This includes project management, content planning, copy and creative briefs, HTML builds, QA, and scheduling. You will manage end-to-end production and keep timelines on track across design, strategy, and client teams. You will work closely with a Retention Marketing Strategist to support retention strategy, reporting, and ongoing optimization. If you enjoy organized workflows, sharp deadlines, clean builds, and improving the customer journey through thoughtful messaging, you will do well here.

What You Will Do


You will manage the full production process for email campaigns and automated flows, build emails in Klaviyo or similar ESPs, write on-brand copy, create clear briefs for the design team, QA content and logic, and schedule deployments. You will maintain the monthly content calendar, drive timelines with clients, and ensure all assets and approvals stay on track. You will support the Retention Marketing Strategist by pulling performance data, analyzing results, and developing recommendations. You will build automated workflows, segmentation, and list logic, maintain list hygiene, and work confidently with Shopify apps such as Yotpo, Loyalty Lion, JustUno, and Privy.

Based on our projected customer base growth, we foresee the need for a Retention Marketing Specialist within the next 2-4 months to ensure we can effectively manage and nurture our expanding user community.

Requirements


What You Need

  • 2 years of experience in retention marketing, specifically across email, SMS, CRM, or loyalty programs.
  • Hands-on experience with an Email Service Platform (ESP), with a strong preference for Klaviyo.
  • Strong copywriting skills for direct-to-consumer (DTC) e-commerce, with the ability to adapt tone and style to match different client brands.
  • A solid understanding of email analytics and the ability to translate data insights into actionable strategy.
  • Clear understanding of the difference between marketing campaigns and automated flows, and knowing when to deploy each.
  • Proficiency in building segmented customer lists using behavioral and transactional data.
  • Experience working within Shopify or directly supporting Shopify-based clients.
  • A proactive, organized approach, with the ability to think through the entire customer journey and work effectively in a fast-paced, collaborative team.

What Success Looks Like


Your production process is smooth, predictable, and organized. Clients trust your communication and follow your timelines. Email and SMS performance improves because of your quality and attention to detail. Strategy and reporting move faster because you stay ahead of data and execution. You keep projects aligned, informed, and on schedule. You take ownership, ask smart questions, and keep work moving forward.

Benefits


This is a contract position

description:

Ser a Melhor Empresa de Saneamento PARA o Brasil.

Nosso modelo de negócios consiste em concessões e parcerias público-privadas (PPPs). Somos uma das principais companhias de saneamento do país, inserida na vida de comunidades de diferentes portes e atendendo milhões de pessoas.

Requisitos e qualificações

Requisitos e Qualificações

  • Ensino Superior Completo em Engenharia Química ou Engenharia Ambiental;

Na Iguá Saneamento valorizamos a diferença em todos os contextos e trabalhamos para promover uma cultura ética e inclusiva sempre. Como companhia e time, buscamos a equidade e respeitamos todos os tipos de diversidade (Gênero, Deficiência - PcD, LGBTQIAPN+, Étnico racial, Crenças e Gerações). Venha fazer parte dessa mudança, acreditamos na força de cada individualidade para gerar transformação

Informações adicionais

Nossos Benefícios
Aqui, cuidamos das nossas pessoas em todas as etapas da sua jornada como colaborador. Conheça o que oferecemos:

Saúde, bem-estar e qualidade de vida

  • Plano de Saúde extensivo aos dependentes

  • Rede de parcerias e descontos em produtos e serviços
  • Programas internos de qualidade de vida: Mente Leve (para de saúde emocional), Convivendo (acompanhamento de colaboradores portadores de doenças crônicas) e o Enxuga (programa de estímulo de hábitos saudáveis) e Melhor Maternidade (acompanhamento de colaboradoras e dependentes gestantes, e crianças até 2 anos).

Alimentação

  • Refeitório ou vale-refeição (conforme operação)

Mobilidade

Incentivos Financeiros

Desenvolvimento e Carreira

  • Programas de mentoria pontuais
  • Os benefícios podem variar de acordo com a unidade, cargo ou regime de contratação, seguindo critérios de elegibilidade, entraremos em detalhe.

VENHA TRABALHAR COM A GENTE

Em 2017, nascemos com um propósito:
ser a MELHOR empresa de saneamento PARA o Brasil.
Desde então, nos consolidamos como uma das principais empresas do setor no país e estamos presentes em seis estados brasileiros (Alagoas, Mato Grosso, São Paulo, Paraná, Rio de Janeiro e Sergipe), beneficiando milhões de pessoas por meio de nossas concessões e parcerias público-privadas. Atuamos com o compromisso de proporcionar mais qualidade de vida e saúde à população atendida, por meio de um trabalho responsável e de excelência no fornecimento de água tratada e nos serviços de coleta, afastamento e tratamento de esgoto.

Mais do que uma atividade empresarial, encaramos a universalização do saneamento básico como um compromisso de larga escala com a vida, com as pessoas, com o meio ambiente, com nossos parceiros e com o desenvolvimento sustentável do Brasil. Esse propósito guia nossas decisões e reforça, todos os dias, o nosso compromisso em cada gota.

O nosso jeito de ser é marcado por um DNA inovador, que promove um ambiente acolhedor, respeitoso e repleto de aprendizados, gerando impacto positivo na sociedade. A valorização e o respeito às diferenças fazem parte da nossa cultura, promovendo uma atuação ética, inclusiva e um ambiente psicologicamente seguro para mulheres, pessoas com deficiência, pessoas negras, pessoas LGBTQIA+, independentemente de crenças, idade ou qualquer outro marcador social ou identitário. Buscamos equidade e respeito em nossas equipes e acreditamos na força de cada individualidade para gerar transformação. Já somos mais de
2.800 colaboradores
e seguimos com perspectivas de ir ainda mais longe.

Você já se perguntou qual é o seu propósito e que história deseja escrever para a sua vida e carreira? Sempre sonhou em ter um papel protagonista e impactar positivamente a vida de milhares de pessoas? Aqui, você pode fazer parte dessa transformação.

#VemSerIguá

Vamos construir um futuro melhor, Iguá Saneamento.

The Retention Marketing Specialist owns the day-to-day execution of email and SMS production for our clients. You will manage end-to-end production and keep timelines on track across design, strategy, and client teams. Based on our projected customer base growth, we foresee the need for a  Retention Marketing Specialist  within the next 2-4 months to ensure we can effectively manage and nurture our expanding user community.

  • 2 years of experience in retention marketing, specifically across email, SMS, CRM, or loyalty programs.

  • Strong copywriting skills for direct-to-consumer (DTC) e-commerce, with the ability to adapt tone and style to match different client brands.
  • A solid understanding of email analytics and the ability to translate data insights into actionable strategy.
  • Clear understanding of the difference between marketing campaigns and automated flows, and knowing when to deploy each.
  • Proficiency in building segmented customer lists using behavioral and transactional data.
  • Experience working within Shopify or directly supporting Shopify-based clients.
  • A proactive, organized approach, with the ability to think through the entire customer journey and work effectively in a fast-paced, collaborative team.

Your production process is smooth, predictable, and organized. Clients trust your communication and follow your timelines. ABS Interns are integrated into ABS business operations and will experience various aspects of engineering review, technical problem solving, and/or research and development.     • Technical Plan Review.
    • Research and Product Development.
    • Operational Safety and Evaluation.
    • Data Science and Digital Services

  • May assist in the development of business performance metrics including the development and implementation of an ongoing business performance monitoring program, and the periodic analysis of operating results to determine causes, trends, etc.
  • May assist with the writing and presentation of technical papers and reports concerning areas of expertise and work performed.
  • May assist with Rule development projects as assigned.
  • Interns may collaborate with the digital team and with other departments such as services, class, project management, commercial operations, etc.
  • Intern may assist with data collection efforts for data quality improvement, in both existing and new data streams to support overall business goals.

What You Will Need:

Education and Experience

  • Bachelor's degree in progress in Chemical Engineering (other related Engineering degrees – e.g., Mechanical, Production, Safety, Process – may be considered).
  • Currently enrolled from the 6th semester (or equivalent) onwards.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

  • Strong interest in risk analysis, process safety and process engineering, especially in sectors such as marine/offshore, oil & gas and mining.
  • Availability to work 30 hours per week (e.g., 6 hours per day, Monday to Friday), during business hours.
  • Intermediate knowledge of MS Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint) – especially Excel for data treatment and KPI/risk indicator analysis.
  • Good written and verbal communication skills in English (and Portuguese).
  • Organization, attention to detail and interest in quality, risk and safety from a systems and process perspective.
  • Analytical mindset and genuine interest in working with data, engineering information and risk scenarios.
  • Proactivity and curiosity to understand client processes, technologies and risk scenarios in marine/offshore, oil & gas, mining and other industrial sectors.
  • Attention to detail and rigor in technical documentation, records and analyses.
  • Teamwork and collaboration, with ability to interact with multidisciplinary technical teams (engineering, operations, safety, quality, etc.).
  • Good organizational skills to manage multiple analytical tasks and deadlines.
  • Ethical behavior, focus on safety and alignment with ABS values of integrity and responsibility.

It would be nice if you had: 

  • Academic or extracurricular experience related to process safety, risk assessment, reliability, process simulation or industrial operations.
  • Basic understanding of risk analysis methods (e.g., HAZID, HAZOP, Bow-tie, LOPA, FMEA) and/or management systems (ISO 9001, ISO 14001, ISO – even if only from university courses.
  • Familiarity with process flowcharts, PFDs, P&IDs and basic process engineering concepts (mass/energy balance, unit operations, etc.).
  • Experience with spreadsheets and basic data analysis (advanced Excel, simple dashboards, basic BI tools) is a plus.

Reporting Relationships:

You'll work alongside engineer colleagues reporting into a Senior Manager. colleguages
